tools.name: calculate_cac
tools.description: Calculate Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) given total marketing and sales spend and the number of new customers acquired in a period.

total_spend_usd.description: Total marketing and sales spend for the period in USD

new_customers.description: Number of new customers acquired in the same period

tools.name: calculate_crm_roi
tools.description: Calculate the ROI of replacing spreadsheets or off-the-shelf tools with a custom Go-Orca CRM. Returns estimated annual savings, ROI percentage, and payback period.

team_size.description: Number of people who will use the CRM

hours_per_week_lost.description: Hours lost per person per week due to inefficient tools

average_hourly_rate.description: Average hourly cost per employee in USD

monthly_tool_costs.description: Current monthly spend on CRM or SaaS tools in USD

crm_investment.description: Estimated one-time CRM build investment in USD

tools.name: estimate_crm_cost
tools.description: Estimate the cost range to build a custom CRM with Go-Orca based on team size, required modules, and number of integrations.

team_size.description: Number of people who will use the CRM
